# Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs — facts

## How it works

- [statement] For the additive-fee calculation described in the cited Jupiter fee snapshot, do not substitute total long-minus-short OI for the imbalance feature. The snapshot defines the imbalance as recent net long-minus-short flow: long opens and short closes add, short opens and long closes subtract, and liquidations count. It explicitly distinguishes this measure from total long-minus-short open interest. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/fees.md · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs
- [statement] Gauntlet’s July 2024 Jupiter dashboard explanation defines long/short OI as notional amounts of currently open positions and describes an RPC finalization buffer plus last-updated timestamps. This is historical measurement context, not proof that the dashboard or its liquidity definitions remain unchanged. Preserve observation time and finalization policy when reusing its data. (low confidence) — https://discuss.jup.ag/t/gauntlets-real-time-dashboard-explained/20114 · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Bybit warns that OI data may arrive late during extreme volatility. Coin Metrics states that some liquidation timestamps are receive times and that many venues cannot backfill missed real-time liquidation data. Inference: store receipt time separately, enforce availability cutoffs and mark gaps before using these features in a historical decision replay. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/open-interest · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://gitbook-docs.coinmetrics.io/market-data/market-data-overview/market-liquidations

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] For mappings based on the cited Jupiter documentation snapshots, keep JLP markets separate from Beta. Those snapshots describe Beta as using maker/taker fees and hourly funding instead of JLP borrow fees, and as using the GUM orderbook engine rather than JLP keepers and custody accounts. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/fees.md · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/technical-reference.md
- [statement] In the cited Jupiter liquidation and technical-reference snapshots, JLP liquidation triggers use the JLP oracle price and continuously accruing borrow fees reduce collateral. The technical reference warns that Jupiter prices can differ from other venues. When modeling that documented design, external liquidation prices are not direct JLP liquidation labels. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/liquidation.md · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/technical-reference.md
- [statement] For Coin Metrics liquidation data, buy denotes a forced buy closing a short, while sell denotes a forced sell closing a long. Its series aggregate exchange-reported events within the coverage universe, rather than establishing an exhaustive count of every economic liquidation on every venue. Preserve provider, exchange coverage and forced-order side. (low confidence) — https://gitbook-docs.coinmetrics.io/market-data/market-data-overview/liquidation-metrics · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs
- [statement] For JLP positions, borrow fees accrue continuously on full position size without compounding. The hourly rate follows a per-asset utilization curve; longs use the market asset custody and shorts use USDC custody. A rate named borrow is therefore a liquidity-utilization cost feature, rather than a signed long-to-short funding transfer. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/fees.md · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/beta-markets
- [statement] Funding intervals vary across exchanges. Jupiter Beta displays a one-hour rate, applies funding hourly on the hour UTC using position value at payment, and labels its eight-hour and annualized displays as simple multiples rather than forecasts. Inference: normalize the interval and distinguish projected, displayed and realized funding before transferring a feature. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://www.kaiko.com/resources/funding-rates-and-their-impact-on-perpetual-swap-positions · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/beta-markets
- [statement] Coin Metrics warns that exchange-reported liquidation totals may understate activity because feeds throttle, snapshot or delay events; its raw-feed documentation also distinguishes liquidation orders from confirmed executions. A reported liquidation feature needs exchange, event type and coverage provenance, rather than an assumption of complete executed forced flow. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://gitbook-docs.coinmetrics.io/market-data/market-data-overview/liquidation-metrics · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://gitbook-docs.coinmetrics.io/market-data/market-data-overview/market-liquidations

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Funding and borrow costs must retain venue and product provenance. The Amberdata article republished by Kaiko describes signed payments between long and short holders, whereas Jupiter documents JLP borrow fees as compensation to liquidity providers for locked capital. A JLP borrow rate is therefore not an interchangeable signed funding or crowd-direction feature. (medium confidence) — https://www.kaiko.com/resources/funding-rates-and-their-impact-on-perpetual-swap-positions · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/fees.md
- [statement] The cited Jupiter fee-documentation snapshot describes JLP borrow charges on the full position size with continuous accrual and no compounding. It assigns longs to the market asset custody utilization curve and shorts to USDC custody utilization, including USDC lent through JLP Loans. For mappings based on this documented design, preserve asset, side and custody as pool-capacity inputs. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/fees.md · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs
- [statement] Bybit documents openInterest as the sum of both sides and singleOpenInterest as a single side. Its inverse BTCUSD examples use USD units, while linear BTCUSDT examples use BTC units. A transfer pipeline must record counting convention and denomination before comparing OI levels or changes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/open-interest · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs
- [statement] Coin Metrics labels liquidation intervals by their start time, although each value sums events across the interval. Its windows are left-inclusive and right-exclusive. Methodological implication: avoid using a completed interval total at that interval start in a signal backtest; retain both event-window boundaries and actual data-availability time. (low confidence) — https://gitbook-docs.coinmetrics.io/market-data/market-data-overview/liquidation-metrics · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs
- [statement] Normalize contract denomination and aggregation scope before cross-venue feature transfer. Bybit OI denomination varies between inverse and linear examples; Coin Metrics warns that exchange-wide native-unit liquidation totals combine different base assets and recommends USD for comparisons across assets or exchanges. Unit normalization alone does not make OI stocks and liquidation flows the same quantity. (medium confidence) — https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/open-interest · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://gitbook-docs.coinmetrics.io/market-data/market-data-overview/liquidation-metrics
- [statement] Jupiter distinguishes oracle-priced SOL, ETH and wBTC JLP markets from GUM orderbook Beta markets. JLP markets charge borrow fees, while Beta markets use funding and maker/taker fees; a generic Jupiter funding feature therefore needs a market-design identifier. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/fees.md · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/beta-markets
- [statement] The JLP custody field `fundingRateState.hourlyFundingDbps` is documented as a legacy linear borrow rate set to 0, with the rate coming from `jumpRateState`. Treating this field as a current orderbook funding signal would misclassify its documented meaning. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/technical-reference.md · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs
- [statement] Bybit documents `openInterest` as the sum of both sides and `singleOpenInterest` as a single side; inverse BTCUSD is measured in USD and linear BTCUSDT in BTC. Jupiter Beta also counts long and short sides together. Cross-venue OI comparisons must preserve both the counting convention and contract denomination. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/open-interest · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/beta-markets
- [statement] JLP custody `assets.guaranteedUsd` is long position size minus collateral, whereas `assets.globalShortSizes` is USD value of all open shorts. These fields are not symmetric long and short notional measures, so their raw difference should not be labeled an OI imbalance without reconstruction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/technical-reference.md · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs
- [statement] Coin Metrics liquidation metrics use buy liquidations for forced closes of shorts and sell liquidations for forced closes of longs. Native-unit exchange aggregates can mix assets; USD normalization improves unit comparability but does not repair omitted events or missing reference-rate exclusions. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://gitbook-docs.coinmetrics.io/market-data/market-data-overview/liquidation-metrics · keywords: Funding open-interest and liquidation feature transfer across perp venue designs
